response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - (SELECT AVG(number_of_orders) FROM order_counts) AS difference_from_overall_average FROM order_counts), regional_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(difference_from_overall_average) AS average_difference FROM differences GROUP BY region) SELECT d.account_id, d.region, d.number_of_orders, d.difference_from_overall_average, d.difference_from_overall_average - r.average_difference AS exceeds_region_average_by FROM differences AS d JOIN regional_averages AS r ON r.region = d.region WHERE d.difference_from_overall_average > r.average_difference ORDER BY exceeds_region_average_by DESC LIMIT 10
